Custom Email Domain on the device vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume iCloud+ Mail domain messaging covers storefront language. iOS account settings and App Store Connect actually separate system domain setup from product-page copy:

  • Custom Email Domain on the device — iCloud+ subscribers add a personal domain under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Mail → Custom Email Domain, add DNS records at their domain registrar, complete domain verification, and create Mail addresses like you@yourdomain.com. System iCloud+ behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • DNS and registrar configuration — buyers add TXT, MX, or CNAME records at their domain host to verify ownership and route Mail. Configuring buyer DNS or domain registrars is user-side setup — AppLocale does not configure DNS for buyers and does not verify domains on their behalf.
  • Custom Email Domain marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app works with Custom Email Domain, recommends personal-domain Mail setup, or walks through DNS verification. Connect text fields — this page.

  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Custom Email Domain positioning in the app.

An app that references Custom Email Domain in onboarding and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe bring-your-own domain Mail setup on the store page, not whether a buyer's domain is verified on their Apple Account.

自定义电子邮件域名 vs 自定义邮箱域名

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 自定义电子邮件域名 or 自定义邮箱域名 for the Custom Email Domain feature under Apple 账户 → iCloud → 邮件. Product-page copy may use either term on screenshot overlays depending on frame context. AppLocale picks the term buyers recognize on each frame — a Settings walkthrough needs Settings-aligned phrasing; a benefit headline may use 自定义邮箱域名 when accurate to your English source.

iCloud+ 自有域名 and 个人域名邮箱 (bring your own domain)

US pages use "Bring your own domain", "Personal domain email", or "Use your domain with iCloud Mail." China storefront copy uses iCloud+ 自有域名 or 个人域名邮箱 when describing addresses like you@yourdomain.com — not Hide My Email 随机邮件地址 vocabulary and not generic third-party email-hosting product claims unless your app genuinely sells those.

域名验证 (DNS domain verification)

Domain setup lives under Settings → Apple Account (Apple ID) → iCloud → Mail → Custom Email Domain on Chinese iPhones and Macs. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to domain verification should use the Chinese settings path buyers see on device — not iCloud → Hide My Email like relay lists, and not iCloud → Manage Storage like storage plan tiers.

Custom Email Domain is under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Mail → Custom Email Domain. iCloud+ subscribers add a personal domain, complete DNS domain verification at their registrar, and create Mail addresses like you@yourdomain.com.
